cards.ex: I'm really pressed for time this week; can we reschedule?
cards.exUz: Bu hafta vaqtim juda tig'iz; boshqa kunga ko'chirsak bo'ladimi?

cards.ex: We're ahead of schedule on the project, so we can relax a bit.
cards.exUz: Loyihada rejadan oldindamiz, shuning uchun biroz dam olsak bo'ladi.

cards.ex: Unfortunately, we're running behind schedule due to the weather.
cards.exUz: Afsuski, ob-havo tufayli rejadan orqada qolyapmiz.

cards.ex: I cut it close getting to the airport, but I made my flight.
cards.exUz: Aeroportga zo'rg'a yetib keldim, lekin samolyotga ulgurdim.

cards.ex: The ambulance arrived in the nick of time to save him.
cards.exUz: Tez yordam uni qutqarish uchun vaqtida yetib keldi.

cards.ex: We're up against the clock to finish the presentation by tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Ertaga taqdimotni tugatish uchun vaqtga qarshi kurashyapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt juda kam bo'lgan sharoitda ishlash.

cards.ex: Time flies when you're having fun!
cards.exUz: Qiziqarli ish bilan vaqt uchadi!

cards.ex: I need to make time for exercise this week.
cards.exUz: Bu hafta sport bilan shug'ullanish uchun vaqt ajratishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir ish uchun vaqt topish.

cards.ex: Take your time, there's no rush.
cards.exUz: Shoshilmang, hech qayerga shoshmayapmiz.

cards.ex: We ran out of time to finish the last question on the exam.
cards.exUz: Imtihonda oxirgi savolni tugatishga vaqtimiz yetmadi.

cards.ex: We need to set a deadline for this project soon.
cards.exUz: Tez orada ushbu loyiha uchun muddat belgilashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir ishni tugatish uchun oxirgi muddatni belgilash.

cards.ex: It's important to meet all deadlines to avoid penalties.
cards.exUz: Jarima to'lamaslik uchun barcha muddatlarga yetish muhim.

cards.ex: I missed the deadline for submitting the application.
cards.exUz: Ariza topshirish muddatini o'tkazib yubordim.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan muddat ichida ishni tugata olmaslik.

cards.ex: Can we extend the deadline by a week?
cards.exUz: Muddatni bir haftaga uzaytirsak bo'ladimi?

cards.ex: He arrived way ahead of time for the meeting.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilishga juda erta keldi.

cards.ex: I can't come at such short notice.
cards.exUz: Men bunchalik qisqa vaqt ichida kela olmayman.

cards.ex: The meeting starts at 9:00 am on the dot.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilish soat ertalab 9:00 da aniq boshlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan vaqtda, bir daqiqa ham kechikmasdan.

cards.ex: The doctors worked around the clock to save the patient.
cards.exUz: Shifokorlar bemorni qutqarish uchun tunu kun ishlashdi.

cards.ex: Investing in education is beneficial in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda foydali.

cards.ex: We were killing time at the airport waiting for our flight.
cards.exUz: Biz aeroportda samolyotimizni kutib, vaqt o'tkazayotgan edik.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtni band qilish, zerikmaslik uchun biror narsa qilish.

cards.ex: Rescuing the trapped miners was a race against time.
cards.exUz: Qamalib qolgan konchilarni qutqarish vaqt bilan poyga edi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt yetishmasligi sababli shoshilinch ravishda harakat qilish.

cards.ex: He submitted his application at the eleventh hour.
cards.exUz: U arizasini so'nggi daqiqada topshirdi.

cards.ex: I do the same routine day in, day out.
cards.exUz: Men kundan-kunga bir xil ishni qilaman.

cards.ex: I lost track of time while reading that book.
cards.exUz: Kitob o'qiyotganda vaqtni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Vaqtni hisobdan chiqarish, vaqtning o'tishini sezmaslik.

cards.ex: In this situation, time is of the essence.
cards.exUz: Bu vaziyatda vaqt g'animat.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt juda muhim, tezroq harakat qilish kerak.

cards.ex: I'm tired, let's call it a day.
cards.exUz: Charchadim, keling, ishni tugatamiz.
cards.uzDef: Kunning ishini yakunlash, dam olishga qaror qilish.

cards.ex: I need to buy some time to finish the report.
cards.exUz: Hisobotni tugatish uchun menga biroz vaqt sotib olish kerak.

cards.ex: Your request will be processed in due course.
cards.exUz: Sizning so'rovingiz o'z vaqtida ko'rib chiqiladi.

cards.ex: Summer is just around the corner!
cards.exUz: Yoz yaqin orada!

cards.ex: Try not to procrastinate on important tasks.
cards.exUz: Muhim vazifalarni kechiktirmaslikka harakat qiling.
